sources.title: yiannis3/Wearable-Sensor-Activity-Classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: The full project built an Android app that consumes wearable sensor streams (accelerometer/IMU and respiration-related signals) and performs on-device classification for daily activities and social/respiratory events. This repository focuses on the ML side: model training, evaluation, and TensorFlow Lite export to support on-device inference.

sources.title: Wearable Activity Dataset ⌚ — Fitness & Health Tracking Data
sources.snippet: This dataset contains wearable fitness and biometric data, modeled on devices like the Apple Watch. All entries are synthetic, privacy-safe, and ready for ML pipelines. Suitable for predictive modeling, activity classification, and LLM-based experiments.
